method: Measured by the P2-08 spec-tester on 2026-10-21: the Astro template built for production (astro build) and served by astro preview against a seeded API; Chromium (Playwright) loaded / until network idle; scriptBytes is the sum over the page's script responses of gzip(body) at zlib's default level. astro preview does not compress, so the wire size is the raw size.
